sm.$description: 14px. Small glyph box, for dense text and compact controls.

md.$description: 20px. Default glyph box, matching the 1.25em SJButton icon box.

lg.$description: 24px. Large glyph box, the native grid of the icon set.

width.$description: Stroke weight of every icon, in the 24-unit icon grid (the set's native weight). Themes thin it through the --sj-icon-stroke hook.
